race.description: Bet365 Same Race Multi Mdn Plate
race.comment: PRESS JONKIT (5) is a gelding from the Lindsay Park stable who hasn't raced since finishing 4 lengths back in sixth over 975m at this track five-and-a-half months ago. Has been the trials three times since, winning each of them, so looks to have taken great improvement between campaigns. LOCARD (11) is a Godolphin blueblood from the all-conquering Maher camp who showed good early dash before weakening to be beaten 4.5 lengths into fourth over 1000m at Ballarat last time out. Will find this much more to her liking. TITUS AUGUSTUS (2) ran a better race last start to finish a close second over 1100m at Mildura after missing the placings at the previous appearance. Taking on a better field but he is up to the task. HANSA DANCA (4) is one of a number of first-starters and did enough in a recent trial win to suggest there's something, but does have a tricky gate. NODDY'S GIRL (10) has been terrible in 3 starts to date, but has trialled nicely since changing stables.
